codeFindings: Central-directory length is checked before ZipFile construction; preparse has exactly thirteen iterations and rejects unproved names, extras, comments, disks and required versions.
The ordinary parser sees only a fully bounded 749-byte central directory; no attacker-controlled entry-count allocation precedes the bound.
NotImplementedError from the library is converted into BundleError by the public validation API.
Existing source hashing, CRC checks and Windows no-overwrite publication are retained.
remaining: Real source symlink creation test is skipped due to Windows privilege; reparse-attribute and ZIP-link rejection branches pass.
Scope remains native-artifact copy-only; independent metadata generation and device/media acceptance remain unproved.
